items.item_text: Basic Life Support - CPR
Bachelors Science in Pharmacy
One year of work experience in a retail pharmacy setting and

Facilitates accurate, safe, efficient, and timely dispensing of prescription and OTC medications in accordance with Company and department policies and procedures, and all state and federal regulations
Counsels, and educates patient, physicians, residents, nurses and other healthcare providers on drug/OTC information in accordance with state law
Oversees and directs the workflow of pharmacy ancillary staff

Accurately complete prescription orders received from patients and providers to include data entry, data verification, drug utilization review (i.e dosing and indication verification, therapeutic duplications and interactions, allergy review, and other safety verifications), filling, labeling, final product verification, and staging for delivery
Consults with insurance companies to obtain authorization for prescription coverage.
Follow-up with medical providers to clarify prescribed medications and prescriptions
Handles customer service issues as appropriate
Answers the telephone in a courteous and timely manner
Able to assist and perform basic cash register operations in accordance with cash handling policies

Works collaboratively with all pharmacy staff to meet operational, financial, and customer service goals to include inventory management and reduced prescription wait times through adherence to applicable departmental policies
Participates in department quality programs as evidenced by documentation of meeting attendance, meeting participation and reports produced.
Keeps pharmacy surface areas, shelving, equipment and flooring clean, neat and well organized as evidenced by inspection
Responsible for opening and closing of pharmacy and shift change duties
Maintain current knowledge, skills, and best practices as related to retail pharmacy and healthcare.
Maintains current knowledge of information technology associated with pharmacy systems

Cultural Sensitivity and Competence: Demonstrates proper use of communication tools/materials for effective communication and understands how the culture(s) of patient populations can affect communication, collaboration and the provision of care, treatment and services

Other duties performed may include, but are not limited to: routine immunizations, travel immunizations, compounding, bedside delivery with medication consultation or meds to beds program, participation in applicable collaborative practice agreements or therapy protocols, MTM participation
PharmD from an accredited school of pharmacy
Pharmacist: CA
Doctor Of Pharmacy PharmD from an accredited school of pharmacy, upon hire
